accounts.rationale: High pass-through ratio with only a single payee and involvement in two other fraud cases strongly indicate mule behavior. Although the tainted share is low and the device is not yet linked to confirmed mules, the forwarding pattern and repeat appearances across complaints outweigh those factors.
